title: Erykah Badu Engineers 2026 Soul Train Cypher Featuring Rapsody & More
summary: Muni Long, Lucky Daye & Mickey Guyton will also perform; special tributes set for Freddie Jackson & Dolly Parton.
contentText:
Erykah Badu, Rapsody, CeeLo Green, Dave Hollister and Avery Wilson are the featured performers cast in the 2026 Badu Cypher — this year’s edition of the generational showcase that’s a staple of the Soul Train Awards. Making its return after a two-year hiatus , the upcoming celebration will air Nov. 27 on BET and CBS (8 p.m. ET/PT).

Five-time Grammy Award winner Badu produced and directed the cypher, which is being presented by Spotify. She took home her latest Grammy in 2025 for best melodic rap performance alongside Rapsody for their collaboration “3:AM.” Badu teamed with producer The Alchemist for her latest album Before the World Blows . Rapsody is a newly minted 2027 Grammy nominee for best rap album by way of her 2026 release God Gotta Afro & Gold Hoops .

Green, also a five-time Grammy winner, got his start as a member of the hip-hop group Goodie Mob before pairing with producer Danger Mouse as Gnarls Barkley (“Crazy”). Green’s latest project is the EP Finesse with Renegade El Rey and Killer Mike. Rounding out the 2026 Badu Cypher talent pool are Grammy-nominated artists Avery Wilson and Dave Hollister. Wilson’s credits include NBC’s The Voice , the top 20 R&B hit “Kiss the Sky” and singing the national anthem seven times during the New York Knicks’ NBA championship run. R&B/gospel artist Hollister, formerly of BLACKstreet, broke through as a solo artist with the 1999 album Ghetto Hymns . His newest single via Death Row Records is “Voodoo Magic.”

Soul Train Awards 2026 is hosted by Anthony Anderson. The performer lineup includes El DeBarge paying tribute to R&B legend Freddie Jackson in addition to Mickey Guyton, Brittney Spencer and Robert Randolph honoring country icon Dolly Parton. Also performing are Kirk Franklin in addition to Lucky Daye and Muni Long doing a medley together. Fans will be treated as well to performances by special Soul Train award honorees Chaka Khan (Classic Soul), newly minted 2027 Grammy nominee Durand Bernarr (Soul Personified) and Elmiene (New Soul). Being showcased as this year’s BET Amplified artists are JayDon and Jai’Len Josey.

Chicago-bred acts Chance the Rapper, Common, Deon Cole, DeRay Davis, Larenz Tate and LisaRaye McCoy will take the stage as presenters. They will be joined by the aforementioned Long, LeToya Luckett and Brian McIntosh.

For more information, visit the BET website.
